data: 11-byte packets starting with 0x55; 0x51 = acceleration (g), 0x52 = angular rate (deg/s). The probe cube decodes them and streams ACCEL (AX, AY, AZ in g) and GYRO (GX, GY, GZ in deg/s) lines.

test_plan.name: still
test_plan.instruction: Place the sensor flat on the table and keep it completely still.
test_plan.expect: Samples arrive. GX/GY/GZ std < 2 dps and abs_max < 10 dps. AX/AY/AZ std < 0.05 g, and one accel axis mean is close to +/-1 g (gravity).

test_plan.name: motion
test_plan.instruction: Pick up the sensor and tilt or rotate it back and forth.
test_plan.expect: Samples arrive. At least one gyro axis abs_max > 30 dps, or at least one accel axis std > 0.1 g.
